entries.1d4f04cd86c38da6: Amid changes in industrial structure driven by the shift to EV, carbon neutrality and CASE technologies in the automotive industry, the company aims to transform without being bound by its conventional business model and to establish a strong management foundation. As priority issues, it cites the manufacture of labor-saving and labor-reducing equipment and entry into new markets not limited to machine tools and transport equipment, and it is conducting sales activities aiming to win orders for new semiconductor manufacturing equipment and water treatment plants. In responding to globalization, it positions its Vietnamese subsidiary as a base for its Southeast Asia strategy and aims to enter industries beyond transport equipment and expand transactions in ASEAN.
